items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I thought he was an Okie from Muskogee... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, but I never really would. You don't know any Bells from Muskogee?

ctx.x: Yeah, there was a lot of Bells. I thought he was an Okie from Muskogee, you know.
Yeah, but I never really would. You don't know any Bells from Muskogee?
